enumTitles: Position check: liquidation price on 12 exchanges

range.title: Map window

rules.title: Rule
rules.description: rule_test and rule_scan. Up to 3 conditions joined by commas, each metric>threshold or metric<threshold. Metrics: funding_apr_pct, oi_chg_1h_pct, oi_chg_24h_pct, price_chg_1h_pct, price_chg_24h_pct, liq_1h_usd, liq_24h_usd, long_pct. Example: funding_apr_pct<-20,price_chg_24h_pct<-5

coins.title: Coins to scan
coins.description: rule_scan only: the largest by open interest first.
